import mujoco, json
m = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path("mjcf.xml")
joints=[]
for j in range(m.njnt):
    name=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,j)
    jt=m.jnt_type[j]
    tname={0:"free",1:"ball",2:"slide",3:"hinge"}[jt]
    axis=m.jnt_axis[j].tolist()
    if m.jnt_limited[j]:
        rng=m.jnt_range[j].tolist()
    else:
        rng=None
    joints.append({"name":name,"type":tname,"axis":axis,"ctrlrange":rng})
acts=[]
for a in range(m.nu):
    name=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_ACTUATOR,a)
    jid=m.actuator_trnid[a,0]
    jn=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,jid)
    cr=m.actuator_ctrlrange[a].tolist() if m.actuator_ctrllimited[a] else None
    acts.append({"name":name,"joint":jn,"ctrlrange":cr})
sites=[mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_SITE,s) for s in range(m.nsite)]
free=[]
for j in range(m.njnt):
    if m.jnt_type[j]==0:
        bid=m.jnt_bodyid[j]
        free.append(mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY,bid))
print("nv",m.nv,"nu",m.nu,"neq",m.neq)
print("sites",sites)
print("free",free)
print(json.dumps({"joints":joints,"acts":acts},indent=0))
